sections.title: SDK sprawl
body: Use two providers and you have two clients, two error types and two retry stories. Add a third for cost or a fourth for a new model, and provider code starts to leak into business logic.
sections.caption: Two provider cards, each with its own doubled SDK stack.

sections.title: A routing engine, as a library
body: Gateway is a provider-agnostic routing engine in Rust: trait-based adapters for around fifteen cloud providers, including Anthropic, Bedrock and OpenAI, plus named fallback chains, circuit breakers and budget management.
sections.caption: Provider tiles merging into one Rust socket.

sections.title: No extra hop
body: It runs inside your process, not as another service in the request path. You pin a tagged release and your lockfile pins the commit.
sections.caption: Long hop arrow beside a short embedded one.
